  "thinking": "Maya has the pad and a fish plan that matches mine: start at the tail, body to the nose, fins after. I shouldn't grab the pad from her. I'll back the plan and offer to take a piece once it's sketched.",
  "say": "Good plan, Maya. A fish with the tail fin and the body running right should read well. Tom, you take the start at the tail once the sketch is up. When the body's on the pad, I can build the bottom fin if nobody's on it.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 4,
  "point": [4, 10],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Maya holds the pad and is sketching a fish facing right: START at tail, stroke 1 = body top to nose, stroke 2 = body bottom back toward tail, then fins. Tom sets START when stroke 1 is drawn. I offered to take the bottom fin once the body is on the pad. My hands are free; I'll wait for the sketch before building. Don't grab the pad. If Maya hands it on, my fallback sketch is: stroke 1 top of body, stroke 2 bottom, stroke 3 tail base line."
